summary: Enhance your skills with our Advanced Topics in Taxation Planning Training Course. Learn cutting-edge strategies to optimize tax planning and compliance.
lede: Advanced corporate tax planning gives experienced tax and finance professionals a structured way to assess cross-border structures and transaction-driven decisions. Through scenario-based exercises, participants model effective tax and cash outcomes, design transfer-pricing policies, review tax implications of acquisitions and restructurings, and document risks and recommendations for management.
audienceIntro: This taxation planning training is built for professionals who already handle tax and finance decisions and now need to engage with complex, cross-border, and transaction-driven tax issues.
modules: Strategic Tax Planning Foundations and Global Drivers
Measuring Tax Outcomes and Modeling Scenarios
Designing Tax-Efficient Group and Holding Structures
Transfer Pricing Policy Design and Risk Management
Tax Planning in Mergers, Acquisitions, and Restructuring
Indirect Tax, Supply Chain, and Operating Model Planning
Tax Governance, BEPS Compliance, and Strategic Communication
prerequisites: This is an intermediate to advanced course. You should have 3+ years of experience in corporate tax, finance, or audit, with a working knowledge of income tax concepts, deductible vs non-deductible items, and basic group taxation. Prior exposure to cross-border transactions and financial statements is strongly recommended. No coding or programming is required. You should be comfortable interpreting tax legislation summaries, reading double taxation agreement provisions at a high level, and working in Excel or similar tools for basic modeling. Advanced concepts such as BEPS, transfer pricing, and global minimum tax are taught at operational application level, focusing on how to apply and review them in practice rather than on drafting legislation or litigating disputes.
